# Sri Sai Natyalayam

> Vazhuvoor Bharatanatyam and fifteen instruments, taught in small classes by the family that has run this school since 1950.

Website: https://srisainatyalayam.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 44 2224 8374

## Contact
- Sri Sai Natyalayam · No. 1/8, Gowri Colony, Macmillan Main Road, Nanganallur, Chennai 600 061 · Near Macmillan Colony · +91 44 2224 8374 · +91 94446 27526 · srisainatyalayam1950@gmail.com

## Key facts
- founded 1950
- 300 students learning today
- 15 instruments taught

## Facilities
- Vazhuvoor Bharatanatyam
- Nattuvangam
- Folk dance
- Arangetram training
- Certification
- Mirudangam
- Tabla
- Pakawaj
- Keyboard
- Harmonium
- Guitar
- Mandolin
- Sitar
- Drums
- Ukulele
- Skype classes
- Ages 3 to 65

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Sri Sai Natyalayam?
No. 1/8, Gowri Colony, Macmillan Main Road, Nanganallur, Chennai 600 061 (Near Macmillan Colony).

### What facilities does Sri Sai Natyalayam have?
Vazhuvoor Bharatanatyam, Nattuvangam, Folk dance, Arangetram training, Certification, Mirudangam, Tabla, Pakawaj, Keyboard, Harmonium, Guitar, Mandolin, Sitar, Drums, Ukulele, Skype classes, Ages 3 to 65.

### What are the class timings?
Tuesday to Friday 4–8 pm, Saturday 3–7 pm and Sunday 7–11 am. Classes at other times can be arranged individually.

### Can I learn online?
Yes. If the times or location don't suit you, classes are also held over Skype.

### Who can learn?
Students from 3 to 65 years learn dance and music here.

### How do I join Sri Sai Natyalayam?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 44 2224 8374.
